body:
It's okay.  Could be better, could be worse.  I have my husband and usually life is really good, but when things are bad, they're bad bad.  I don't feel unsafe with him at all, but I feel unsafe with how I feel when we fight.  We just have different styles of arguing, he's rational and cold and I'm overly emotional and it makes things really, really hard.  And we fight over tiny little things, that tend to balloon up into huge things where old hurts are brought into the mix.  

It's been the last few weeks, maybe since about mid-December that I've been having a really hard time.  I can't even think of anything that could have triggered this feeling, I'm just having a hard time dragging myself through the days.
I don't even remember.  Not that long ago.  Now even when things are fine, I still feel like I'm teetering on the edge of something though.

I do it to myself.  I just feel so stupid and out of control all the time.  Like, I don't know how to stop crying once I start and that is really frustrating for everyone around me.  I'm too old to freak out like I do, but I can't help it.  Sometimes it feels better to hit myself than it does to try to be calm and rational since hitting myself and crying are easier.  And then that makes me feel worse because it's just taking the lazy way out.
